selectedFunctions.label: Strata srUSDe deposit USDe
warnings: Ethereum srUSDe is the senior tranche, not jrUSDe. Junior capital absorbs losses first but senior principal can still be lost when coverage is exhausted; USDe depeg, Ethena strategy/counterparty, smart-contract, governance and liquidity risks remain. Marketing yield floors and principal protection are not unconditional guarantees.

Amounts are integer raw token/share units, not fiat. USDe is the base asset; the token overloads support the strategy USDe/sUSDe assets only and are not arbitrary-token zaps. USDe, sUSDe and srUSDe amounts are not interchangeable or guaranteed 1:1.

Deposit/mint pull the selected input from msg.sender after approval to srUSDe and mint shares to receiver. Withdrawal/redeem burn owner shares; caller != owner requires sufficient srUSDe share allowance to caller. receiver is the payout/request beneficiary and can differ from owner; choose the intended nonzero address.

USDe exits create an Ethena unstaking request rather than instant USDe delivery under active cooldown; docs currently describe seven days and a separate manual claim. Finalization uses token=sUSDe, user=the exit receiver and pays USDe to the recorded receiver, not to the finalization caller.

sUSDe exits use ERC20Cooldown: docs currently describe instant payout, but the strategy senior cooldown is role-configurable up to seven days. A nonzero cooldown instead queues sUSDe under receiver and requires ERC20Cooldown.finalize(sUSDe,receiver[,at]). No current cooldown, pause, allowance, supported-token mapping or dependency storage read was performed.

CDO deposit/withdraw action states, accounting caps/coverage and shortfall pausing can block calls. Docs describe senior minting suspension below 105% coverage and 2.5 bps redemption fee; live parameters are not attested. Exit fees are configurable (CDO source allows up to 1%).

All eight tranche methods update accounting before quoting. ERC4626 deposit/redeem floor and mint/withdraw ceil conversions use virtual assets/shares; token conversions add their own floor/ceil rounding. sUSDe withdrawal amount is recomputed by strategy from net base assets using previewWithdraw, so a tokenAmount argument/preview is not a guaranteed exact payout.

Every withdrawal/redeem must leave total srUSDe supply >= 0.1e18 shares (MinSharesViolation); the final holder cannot redeem the entire remaining supply. Zero token/base amounts, insufficient balance/allowance and limits revert. Methods have no min-output, max-input or deadline arguments; previews and exchange rates can change.

Cooldown requests merge at 70 active slots or within the same block and can extend a prior unlock. Distinct owner/receiver exits are rejected when receiver already has 40 active slots. The recorded beneficiary, not the permissionless finalizer, receives the claim.

Proxies and owner/role-controlled configuration remain authoritative. Etherscan implementation bindings and verified source are source-service evidence, not fresh RPC bytecode/storage/execution attestation. Admission bypasses no runtime calldata/value/grant checks and promises neither successful execution nor financial safety.

warnings: Ethereum srUSDe is the senior tranche, not jrUSDe. Junior capital absorbs losses first but senior principal can still be lost when coverage is exhausted; USDe depeg, Ethena strategy/counterparty, smart-contract, governance and liquidity risks remain. Marketing yield floors and principal protection are not unconditional guarantees.

Amounts are integer raw token/share units, not fiat. USDe is the base asset; the token overloads support the strategy USDe/sUSDe assets only and are not arbitrary-token zaps. USDe, sUSDe and srUSDe amounts are not interchangeable or guaranteed 1:1.

Deposit/mint pull the selected input from msg.sender after approval to srUSDe and mint shares to receiver. Withdrawal/redeem burn owner shares; caller != owner requires sufficient srUSDe share allowance to caller. receiver is the payout/request beneficiary and can differ from owner; choose the intended nonzero address.

USDe exits create an Ethena unstaking request rather than instant USDe delivery under active cooldown; docs currently describe seven days and a separate manual claim. Finalization uses token=sUSDe, user=the exit receiver and pays USDe to the recorded receiver, not to the finalization caller.

sUSDe exits use ERC20Cooldown: docs currently describe instant payout, but the strategy senior cooldown is role-configurable up to seven days. A nonzero cooldown instead queues sUSDe under receiver and requires ERC20Cooldown.finalize(sUSDe,receiver[,at]). No current cooldown, pause, allowance, supported-token mapping or dependency storage read was performed.

CDO deposit/withdraw action states, accounting caps/coverage and shortfall pausing can block calls. Docs describe senior minting suspension below 105% coverage and 2.5 bps redemption fee; live parameters are not attested. Exit fees are configurable (CDO source allows up to 1%).

All eight tranche methods update accounting before quoting. ERC4626 deposit/redeem floor and mint/withdraw ceil conversions use virtual assets/shares; token conversions add their own floor/ceil rounding. sUSDe withdrawal amount is recomputed by strategy from net base assets using previewWithdraw, so a tokenAmount argument/preview is not a guaranteed exact payout.

Every withdrawal/redeem must leave total srUSDe supply >= 0.1e18 shares (MinSharesViolation); the final holder cannot redeem the entire remaining supply. Zero token/base amounts, insufficient balance/allowance and limits revert. Methods have no min-output, max-input or deadline arguments; previews and exchange rates can change.

Cooldown requests merge at 70 active slots or within the same block and can extend a prior unlock. Distinct owner/receiver exits are rejected when receiver already has 40 active slots. The recorded beneficiary, not the permissionless finalizer, receives the claim.

Proxies and owner/role-controlled configuration remain authoritative. Etherscan implementation bindings and verified source are source-service evidence, not fresh RPC bytecode/storage/execution attestation. Admission bypasses no runtime calldata/value/grant checks and promises neither successful execution nor financial safety.
restrictions.cooldownClaims: USDe request finalization calls UnstakeCooldown with sUSDe token, not USDe. ERC20Cooldown finalizes queued sUSDe directly. Both overloads are permissionless and pay only recorded request beneficiary; neither has a caller-selected payout target independent of that beneficiary. at is a maturity cutoff and cannot exceed block.timestamp. Cooldown-disabled emergency paths bypass maturity filtering; NothingToFinalize rejects no positive claim. Current handler registration and request state remain unverified.
restrictions.noOpaqueExecution: Only explicitly typed multi-token tranche functions and cooldown finalizers are selected. Token is a strategy-supported asset identifier, not an arbitrary route target with opaque calldata. TrancheDepositor routes/executors, protocol component wiring and arbitrary user clone targets are not admitted. Runtime execution scope is unchanged.
restrictions.juniorScope: jrUSDe is first-loss junior risk capital with separate contract, fee, coverage and redemption behavior. No junior operation is admitted via this review, even though Tranche implementation is shared.

sourcesReviewed.evidence: The exact sUSDe deployment code page source inherits maxWithdraw as asset-valued owner balance conversion; StakedUSDe/StakedUSDeV2 sources supplied on that page do not override maxWithdraw. This is a quote prerequisite for meta-deposit, not an assertion that direct sUSDe.withdraw bypasses Ethena cooldown.

nonFunctionEntries: All constructors, events, errors and proxy payable fallbacks are retained only as ABI evidence and create no capabilities. Transparent proxy admin upgrade dispatch is not a user capability.
